FIELDS.NAME: Vacuum Haven
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 12345 Vacuum Way, Suite 100, Cleaning City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vacuum Haven specializes in the retail sale and service of both new and refurbished vacuum cleaners, providing a wide range of models from multiple reputable manufacturers. Our operations include a customer-friendly storefront where shoppers can explore various vacuum cleaner options, as well as a service department staffed with certified technicians who perform in-shop repairs and maintenance for residential and light commercial vacuum cleaners. We adhere strictly to safety protocols and local electrical regulations, ensuring that all staff are documented as receiving comprehensive safety and technical training. In addition, we offer a selection of high-quality accessories, filters, and replacement parts for vacuum cleaners, all sourced from reputable vendors with established quality controls to ensure customer satisfaction and safety. Our commitment to maintaining up-to-date business licenses and compliance with industry standards positions us as a trustworthy choice for all vacuum cleaner needs.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Cleaning Solutions Co. - a small business providing eco-friendly cleaning services and products.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to a customer slipping and falling in the store on 03/15/2022, resulting in a medical claim of $1,200.00; claim is currently under review.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 45678 Cleaner Lane, Suite 200, Sparkle Town, CA 90211-4567
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Onsite security presence during business hours to ensure customer safety and deter theft."
